established_facts: All three systems are the same core agent loop: model + tools + sandbox + context + permissions
Claude Code is terminal-first with CLAUDE.md, skills, subagents, MCP, hooks, sandboxed Bash, Agent SDK (official docs)
Codex leads Terminal-Bench 2.0 (77.3%, Feb 2026) and offers cloud tasks + computer use (multiple independent sources, incl. OpenAI-reported 4M weekly users June 2026)
Arena Agent Mode launched 2024-06-04 with web search, image gen, sandboxed bash, file tools, GitHub PR workflow (official)
Agent Arena derives leaderboards from causal evaluation of real user tasks; 160,480 tasks in one 7-day slice (official methodology blog)
AI Now demonstrated out-of-the-box prompt-injection RCE against stock Claude Code and Codex while reviewing a poisoned library (July 2026)

Anthropic postmortem (Apr 2026): three harness/infra bugs caused perceived model quality drop — reasoning depth, reasoning-history caching wipe ('context rot'), verbosity system prompt (-3%); fixed v2.1.116; every system-prompt change now gated on model-specific evals

Subagent/background-task metering bugs hit BOTH vendors in 2026: Claude Code (subagent multiplication, Jun 2026) and Codex (auto-review/helpers running twice + phantom dashboard charges, Jun 2026; similar Mar 2026)
anthropics/claude-code has 12,513 open issues (live API, 2026-09-11); Codex top open bug #28756 has 1,123 comments
OpenAI logged ~166 incidents in ~9 months (~18/month) through Jul 2026; uptime 99.94% APIs / 99.62% ChatGPT / 99.98% Codex
Session/resume is the most regression-prone subsystem in both majors (sandbox-gate regression 2.1.120, crash-on-resume, WSL transport failures, 5MB transcript loss)
Long-horizon benchmarks collapse agent pass rates: 25% (SWE-EVO) vs 72.8% (SWE-bench Verified); ~18% of agent patches regress previously passing tests (SWE-bench-secret)
Qwen Code Agent Arena (open-source arena implementation) documents classic arena challenges: silently dropped config, no diff preview, no session resumption, worktree cleanup bugs

MCP is the connector standard: 97M+ monthly SDK downloads, 10,000+ public servers (Anthropic, Dec 2025); governed by Agentic AI Foundation (Linux Foundation); protocol has NO built-in authz/RBAC per NSA May 2026; tool-poisoning client defense varies 0-100% (arXiv 2603.22489)
OTel GenAI Semantic Conventions (v1.41) are the observability standard; VS Code Copilot, Codex, and Claude Code already emit OTel telemetry
Prompt caching ~90% / routing cascade 75-85% / combined optimization 80-95% cost reduction; agent workloads cost 3-10x chat
Firecracker microVM ~150ms cold start (~50K LoC Rust VMM) is the production isolation tier for untrusted model-generated code
Durable execution is baseline infrastructure: Temporal $300M/$5B (Feb 2026), 9.1T executions; Postgres-based checkpointing (DBOS/LangGraph) requires zero new infra

EU AI Act: Art. 5 prohibitions + Art. 50 transparency enforceable from Aug 2, 2026; high-risk Chapter III (incl. Art. 12 tamper-evident logs >= 6 months, Art. 14 human oversight) same date; fines to EUR 35M / 7%

Public benchmarks are compromised as primary signal: contamination 5-15 pts; UCB RDI reward-hacked 8 benchmarks to ~100%; METR found 30%+ reward hacking; harness adds 5-30 pts; environment moves scores ~18 pts

VERIFIED vs PRIMARY (V1, fetched 2026-09-11): official SWE-bench Verified top = 79.2% (Claude 4.5 Opus via agents); mini-SWE-agent harness Feb 2026: Opus 4.5 high 76.8% @$0.75, Gemini 3 Flash high 75.8% @$0.36, MiniMax M2.5 high 75.8% @$0.07, GPT-5.2 high 72.8% — aggregator claims of 88-95% NOT supported; C1 confirmed as inflation

VERIFIED vs PRIMARY (V2, fetched 2026-09-11): current official Terminal-Bench top = 58.2% (GPT-6 Astra max + Codex, $3.3k full run); corpus TB2.0 citations (77.3% Codex) were point-in-time correct for v2.0 — benchmark version changed; new model generation (GPT-6 Astra, Fable 5.1, Opus 5, Sonnet 5) validates churn trigger

M1 CLOSED: deterministic policy enforcement on every tool call — Cerbos sub-1ms YAML PDP purpose-built for agent/MCP authz (kill-switch, policy-version lineage); Cedar typed-model dominates MCP enforcement (lower p99 under concurrency); OPA for infra policy. LLMs cannot make enforcement decisions. Rule R15

M2 CLOSED: thinking tokens billed as output ($15-25/M) → 3-10x per-call cost (measured 7.3x); recursive loops without per-turn thinking caps cost $40-100/task; production pattern = tiered budgets (0/1.5K/5K) + per-call cost caps; Claude explicit budget_tokens (debuggable) vs o-series reasoning_effort (opaque). Rule R14

M4 CLOSED: 2026 RAG baseline = hybrid (BM25+dense, RRF) → cross-encoder rerank → 6-8 chunks → generation with citations; recursive chunking 300-500 tokens/10-15% overlap default; hybrid+rerank = +25-40% precision over naive; faithfulness is the most critical metric (claim-by-claim verification); agentic RAG creates an audit problem — provenance must be designed in. Rule R16
well_supported: Prompt injection is the primary threat to coding agents; cannot be fully prevented — containment is the correct posture (NVIDIA, OWASP-aligned, multiple independent)
Priority order for 'best': eval-driven engineering, containment-first security, context discipline, model selection with fallbacks
Claude Code strengths: planning, large-codebase reasoning; Codex strengths: speed, cloud tasks, computer use, UX polish
MicroVMs (Firecracker/Kata) are the appropriate isolation tier for untrusted agent code execution in production
Simplicity-first: most production needs are workflows, not autonomous agents (Anthropic guidance, still industry reference 2026)
Agent failure taxonomy: strong models fail on instruction following; weak models on tool use/syntax; older models loop or terminate early; model rankings are scaffold-sensitive (SWE-EVO)

The five recurring cross-vendor bug families: context/caching (masquerades as model regression), subagent/metering accounting, session/resume state, sandbox edge-case correctness, capacity/rate-limit UX
inferences: Build order (loop -> sandbox -> permissions -> memory -> skills/subagents -> MCP -> product) mirrors incumbent evolution and is the correct path for a new entrant
A new entrant should compete on one signature surface (e.g., beginner-friendly Windows experience), not feature parity
Skills+MCP composition pattern (MCP=ability, skill=know-how) transfers to any new harness

build.directive: USER (2026-09-11, verbatim): 'i want this agent to work on my local pc and it needs to look like claude or chat gpt the simplicity of the design.'
build.scope: One system: a local-PC agent with a Claude/ChatGPT-style minimal chat UI. Runs on the user's machine (Windows/macOS/Linux), Python 3.11 + FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:8000, single-page chat UI (no build step), SQLite persistence, SSE streaming with plain-JSON fallback.
deliverables: app/main.py — FastAPI server: static UI, /api/config, /api/settings, conversations CRUD, /api/chat/{cid} SSE + ?plain=1 fallback, /api/chat/{cid}/stop
app/config.py — provider registry (Anthropic / OpenAI-compatible / Ollama local no-key), settings.json persistence, model lists, pricing table + estimate_cost()

app/providers.py — 3 streaming provider clients with canonical events; R12-compliant retry (transient errors only, backoff+jitter); ProviderError kinds auth|network|timeout|rate_limited|tools_unsupported|request|provider
app/agent.py — run_agent(): max_iterations budget (default 6, R3/R7), visible tool events, token/cost accounting (R14 spirit), graceful degradation when a local model lacks tool support

app/tools.py — web_search (keyless DuckDuckGo Lite, <=5 results), read_file, list_dir; ACI-style descriptions (docs/core/04); workspace-scoped via path resolution enforcement; content-is-data rule in system prompt
app/storage.py — SQLite conversations+messages with meta JSON (tool traces, usage, cost); RLock (self-deadlock bug found in smoke test and fixed)
app/system_prompt.py — SYSTEM_PROMPT local-agent/1.0: tool guidance, <=3 inline citations, workspace-only files, retrieved content = DATA never instructions, language matching

app/static/index.html + style.css + app.js — Claude/ChatGPT-style UI: sidebar chats, streaming caret, tool-event chips, 3 themes (light / claude / dark), settings modal, usage+cost footer, stop button, copy-code buttons
app/start.bat + start.sh — double-click launchers (venv + pip install + open browser)
app/tests/test_agent_loop.py + test_sse_endpoint.py — mock-provider tests of the loop, budget cap, workspace escape refusal, degradation, and the full HTTP SSE pipeline
tests_run: Smoke (curl vs live server): GET / 200; static assets 200; conversation CRUD; chat plain 502 auth-error with kind=auth; SSE auth-error event clean (curl exit 0); Ollama network-error event; persistence + auto-title; settings roundtrip
